name: Yushu Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Yushu Technology Co., Ltd., operating under the brand Unitree Robotics, develops, produces, and sells high-performance quadruped robots and their applications for industrial and consumer use. The company is based in Hangzhou, China, and has subsidiaries in China. The Chinese company offers a range of products including consumer and educational quadruped robots, industrial quadrupeds, humanoid robots, robotic arms, and advanced perception components such as 4D lidar sensors. The company's robots are equipped with advanced sensing systems, AI integration, and versatile operation modes suitable for education, entertainment, industrial inspection, and rescue missions. The company’s solutions address tasks in industries such as power system inspection, fire rescue, agriculture, mining, and public safety, featuring robust, modular designs and advanced navigation capabilities. Unitree Robotics also provides intelligent inspection systems that integrate robots with drones and AI algorithms for autonomous patrols and centralized monitoring. The company was founded in 2016 by Xing Xing Wang. Xing Xing Wang has been the CEO since 2016.
